chansons.style: Reggaeton, latin pop, dembow rhythm, melancholic acoustic guitar, smooth male vocal, lonely party vibe, deep bass, 88 BPM

[Chorus]

Dancing with the silence and the gloom
Solo, solo, hear the dembow cry
Watching all the lonely hours fly

[Verse 2]
People talking but I hear no sound
Feet are moving but I leave no ground
Got the rhythm running through my veins
But I'm hiding from the pouring rains

[Pre-Chorus]
The bass is heavy but my heart is light
Just a shadow in the neon light

[Chorus]
Solo, solo in the empty room
Dancing with the silence and the gloom
Solo, solo, hear the dembow cry
Watching all the lonely hours fly

[Bridge]
One step, two step, turn around
No one here to hold me down

[Chorus]
Solo, solo in the empty room
Dancing with the silence and the gloom
Solo, solo, hear the dembow cry
Watching all the lonely hours fly

[Outro]
Empty room. Just me.
Fading out.
